 Yesterday's Low Pressure Area over South Andaman Sea & adjoining North Andaman Sea and Andaman & Nicobar Islands moved west-northwestwards and lay as a Well Marked Low pressure area over southeast Bay of Bengal and adjoining areas of Andaman & Nicobar Islands and Andaman Sea at 0830 hrs IST of today, the 31st October 2026.
It is very likely to move west-northwestwards and concentrate into a Depression over the same region during next 06 hours. Thereafter, it is very likely to intensify further into a cyclonic storm during subsequent 24 hours, move west-northwestwards and reach over westcentral Bay of Bengal near Andhra Pradesh coast around evening of 2nd November 2026.
